summary: Still too early to judge the news, catalyst and macro-brief layers: only 132 ideas from 6 days (Oct 15-22) have closed, far short of the ~60 ideas over 20+ days the rule needs. The macro-fit backtest (6,382 past setups) again fails: stocks with a recent macro headwind actually did better than those with a tailwind, in both halves, but not by enough to count (t -1.64). The old 5-day swing Top 2 is roughly flat (19 closed, +0.1% avg, 47% winners vs +0.7% for the average candidate). Nothing passed, so nothing should change.
findings: Macro fit (backtest Apr 2025-Oct 2026, 6,382 signals): tailwind +0.47% (n 1,062) vs headwind +1.92% (n 801), t -1.64, both halves negative (-1.0, -1.1 pts). Not proven; info only.
Catalyst positive (forward): +2.7% (n 19) vs -1.1% (n 17), t 0.6, halves disagree (+10.0 / -0.5 pts). Not proven; 6 dates only.
Red flags (forward): no flags +0.8% (n 26) vs flagged +1.2% (n 19), t 0.07, halves disagree. No signal yet.
Earnings inside the hold (forward): clear +2.9% (n 25) vs earnings in hold -1.8% (n 13), t 0.86, both halves same sign but tiny sample. Not proven.
Macro tailwind (forward): 65 vs 1 row, untestable. Macro-brief low risk: 0 low-risk rows, untestable. More support: 5 vs 69 rows, untestable.
No warnings (forward): +3.4% (n 63) vs -1.9% (n 16), no t yet. Interesting direction, sample too small.
By role (132 closed, 5-day vs SPY): pick1 -0.1% (n 6), pick2 +4.1% (n 6), watch +4.2% (n 24), candidates +0.4% (n 96).
Swing Top 2 ledger: 19 closed, avg +0.12% with stops vs +0.69% avg candidate, 47% winners; 9 open, 2 no fill. Setup review flag: off (regime mixed, 20 days since baseline).
proposals: No changes yet: not enough data. Forward log has 132 settled ideas over 6 dates; the rule needs 20+ dates (about mid-to-late November).
Keep macro fit as information only: it failed again (t -1.64). If anything it hints at mean reversion; not worth acting on unless t reaches -2 in both halves.
Watch 'earnings inside the hold' and 'no warnings': both point the expected way; re-check when 20+ dates have settled. Any promotion would still need Adam's approval.
